title: Tahn's VanillaPlus
description: Basically vanilla Minecraft with added FPS and QoL mods , plus audio/visual details.
body:
# ![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4463a35141c17c01ac2d7aac6c64ae3df48ccf1_0.webp)

## **Welcome to Tahn's Vanilla Plus modpack!**

**A modpack created to keep Minecraft as close to vanilla as possible, while keeping framerates high, it contains a lot of optimization mods, and some great quality of life mods.**

Sodium, Lithium, Ferrite Core, Immediatly Fast and others keep the FPS up, while a minimap, Controlify and others sustain a beter, smoother Minecraft experience.

Also included are mods to add audio-visual details and animations to propel Minecraft to the next level.

Originally created for the Steamdeck, but can basically be used on any computer. Shaders can be turned off for potato computers.
